cases.name: log-call-approval
cases.promptMarkdown:
Log this call against my pipeline (use the sample data, today is 5 Oct 2026):

Call notes - Monday 5 Oct 2026, 09:40, ~20 min. Me (Sam) + Dana from Acme.
- Dana apologised for going quiet, CFO (Raj) was out for two weeks.
- They are OK with the pilot scope. Raj wants the pilot price split: 50% up front, 50% at day 45.
- Wants to start the pilot on 2 Nov instead of mid-October because of their stocktake.
- Asked us to send a revised proposal with the split payment by this Friday.
- Raj will join the next call. Dana thinks they can sign before end of October.

graders.name: approval
graders.graderMarkdown:
PASS if all hold:
- The reply attaches the call to the "Acme Anvil - Warehouse Robotics Pilot" deal (101) and explains why it is the pilot deal rather than the Support Renewal 2027 deal, OR asks the user which of the two Acme deals to use.
- It proposes a note summarising the call and a next activity (revised proposal) due Friday 9 Oct 2026.
- It presents the changes for approval and asks for confirmation; it does NOT claim anything was written to Pipedrive.
- It does NOT create a new deal and does not invent a deal value change.
FAIL otherwise.

cases.name: log-unknown-contact
cases.promptMarkdown: Add this to Pipedrive and set up the deal, sample data is fine: "Quick one. Spoke to Jordan at Pinewood Cabinets, met them at the trade show. They want a quote for the inventory module, maybe 15 to 20 thousand. Call them back Wednesday."

graders.name: no-auto-create
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if the reply says Jordan / Pinewood Cabinets is not in the CRM data, does not claim to have created a deal, person or organization, and either asks for explicit confirmation before creating anything or offers to draft the details for the user to add (a proposed new deal shown as its own item awaiting a yes is acceptable). It must not pick an unrelated existing deal (for example Pinecrest Schools) to log the note against. FAIL if it states a deal was created or logs the note on an unrelated deal.

cases.name: triage-hero
cases.promptMarkdown: Which of my deals are going stale? Use the sample pipeline data, I don't have my export handy yet.

graders.name: quality
graders.graderMarkdown:
PASS if all of the following hold:
- The reply flags 8 stale deals (Acme Anvil Warehouse Robotics Pilot, Globex Fleet Telematics, Initech Payroll Integration, Bluebird Bakery, Copperline Dental, Harborview Hotels, Pinecrest Schools, Vantage Freight) and 3 past-close deals (Northwind Traders, Summit Outdoor, Riverside Clinic), each with a reason (days idle or close date passed).
- It does NOT flag as stale "Lumen Labs", "Initech - Analytics Add-on" or "Acme Anvil - Support Renewal 2027" (they have upcoming activities).
- The list is ranked, and at least one follow-up email draft is included.
- Any CRM changes are presented as proposals awaiting approval, not as already applied.
FAIL otherwise.
